newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cargolux Mar 1997 traffic up 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux Mar 1997 traffic up 17 pct.

text.p: Cargolux Airlines International said it flew 203.7 million freight tonne kilometres (FTK) last month, up 17 percent on March 1996.
The Luxembourg-based cargo airline flew 525.0 million FTK in the first quarter of 1997, an increase of 14 percent on the same period last year.
Cargolux operates a fleet of three Boeing 747-400Fs and is to take delivery of a further two 400Fs later this year.
It also operates four 747-200Fs, including one on leaseback. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
